required_files: Work object: authorized local RV64 OoO RTL and simulation evidence only. Focus on STORE queue request_sent ownership and AMO singleton mem_amo_write_sent residency until exact transaction terminal response. No repository writes.

deliverables: A review report with explicit PASS, GAP, or inconclusive status; all STORE and AMO state-clear paths; exact cycle-by-cycle invariants; assessment of an external wrapper checker using read-only hierarchy references; minimal compile-success RTL variants that current same-edge assertions miss; unknowns, counterexamples, alternatives, requested scope extensions, and confidence.
